text: Current remote MCP access is OAuth-based, with selected site/workspace authorization, automatic refresh, and no local API-key storage.
MCP authorization is constrained by existing Webflow roles; site owners/admins authorize the server and each authorization is limited to one workspace.
OAuth Data Client, site-token, workspace-token, and local WEBFLOW_TOKEN stdio paths are distinct credential/deployment models.
Scopes are resource-specific; OAuth requests must be registered subsets, site and workspace scopes differ, and custom_code scopes are unavailable to site tokens.
Official guidance requires secure secret storage, minimal scopes, rotation/revocation, and recognizes Beta but not a documented staging sandbox or non-production credential class.
Current deployed MCP documentation describes remote OAuth while the official OSS repository describes local stdio with WEBFLOW_TOKEN; treat them as separate deployment modes.
No official fetched source established that the Beta MCP server is an isolated staging environment.
